conflicts.note: InteractiveScene is exclusive to ManimGL. In Manim Community Edition, standard Scene must be used, and interactive features or specific camera controls must be adapted manually.

apply_complex_function is highly optimized in ManimGL. In ManimCE, apply_function can be used by converting 3D coordinates (x, y, z) to complex numbers, applying the function, and converting back to 3D space.
TexturedSurface and Square3D are specialized OpenGL constructs in ManimGL. Porting this to ManimCE requires custom shader/texture mapping or using standard 2D image mobjects with warp functions.
